blocks.text: TACLOBAN CITY — The city government will implement a four-day compressed workweek for most offices starting Nov. 3 as part of its energy conservation measures in anticipation of the effects of El Niño. Mayor Alfred Romualdez issued Memorandum Order No. 2026-10-435, dated Oct. 27, directing city government offices to operate from Monday to Thursday, from 7:30 a.m. to 6:30 p.m., with Friday designated as a non-working day. The measure covers all city government departments, offices, and employees, including permanent, casual, contract-of-service, and job-order workers.
